title: Stucco to James Hardie lap siding
summary: A two-storey house whose rear elevation was tired grey stucco. It came off; James Hardie lap siding went on, with the trim, the porch columns and the fascia all rebuilt to match.
beforeAlt: The rear of a two-storey Los Angeles house before the work: grey-beige stucco walls, dark shutters, a screened porch and a mature tree in the lawn.
alt: The same rear elevation after the work: pale James Hardie lap siding across both storeys, white trim around the windows and porch columns, the same shutters and tree.
